caption: Eight lines you'll reuse in Lesson 13's lab and every later gate-building exercise in this course.

code:
Y = np.array([[0, -1j], [1j, 0]])
is_unitary(Y), is_hermitian(Y)
# (True, True)

S = np.array([[1, 0], [0, 1j]])
is_unitary(S), is_hermitian(S)
# (True, False)
caption: S is a perfectly legal gate, but it does not correspond to a measurable physical observable.
